title: Horae marketplace index
description: marketplace.json: maps a plugin name to its git repository, its released versions (each pinned to a full commit SHA) and a tier. Mirrors PLAN.md section 4 and the lockfile contract of the core (schemas/lockfile/v1.json): same name, semver, https repo URL and commit patterns.

plugins.description: One entry per plugin name. Names must be unique (checked by the verify script, which JSON Schema cannot express for an array of objects).

name.description: The plugin name used in `horae plugin add <name>@<version>`.

repo.description: https git URL of the plugin repository (no port, user info, query or fragment; no `.` or `..` segment; not localhost).

versions.description: Released versions: semver -> the full 40-hex commit SHA the tag `v<version>` points to. Nothing resolves a tag at install time; the SHA is the pin.

tier.description: `first-party`: maintained in the horae-dev organization. `community`: anyone else.
